name: The Base Mesh
creator: Tim Steer
description: 1,360 CC0 base meshes from thebasemesh.com — clean topology, real-world scale and basic UVs, converted to glTF binary. Props, furniture, architecture, food, tools, nature and more, every model with a rendered thumbnail and an animated turntable preview.
coverCredit: Official artwork from thebasemesh.com, a render of the meshes in this pack.
conversionCredit: glTF conversion by the M3-org/base-meshes project (https://github.com/M3-org/base-meshes).
